title: fix(driver-sql): an upgraded MySQL 8 database retires the narrower key beside the functional package-less guard
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D4Jsmd91BqTVB7dSii9uJMV)_
Fixes #33201
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`driver-sql` 的扩键迁移现在能认出 MySQL 8 上平台自建的「无包守卫」(函数式键部件 + 驱动自己的哈希摘要),把它当作部分唯一索引,于是升级过的 MySQL 库会像 PostgreSQL 一样把旧的窄唯一键安全替换掉。
- **为什么改**:此前 MySQL 上旧键永远被保留,同一组织里两个包的同名权限集授权、同名连接器实例、同名激活记录都被拒,用户无法绕过。
- **风险与回滚**:识别是严格匹配(整段表达式 + 摘要必须与驱动自身的摘要构造器逐字一致 + 作用域列必须是新增的唯一可空列),运维自建的函数索引不会被误认;回滚即 revert 本 PR,旧键回到「保留」状态,不丢数据。
- **先看**:`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts`(`parseFunctionalRowScopedGuard` 与 `hasPartialUniqueGuard` 新分支,风险最高);`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-column-creation.ts`(摘要构造器抽出,须逐字节不变);`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-widened-declared-unique.test.ts`(严格性反例)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-widened-declared-unique.test.ts`,预期纯函数段「a functional row-scoped digest (MySQL 8 package-less guard)」全绿;CI 的 `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` 中三个 MySQL 单元为 replace。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地(含对 `.changeset/31699-connection-key-package.md` 的 DELIBERATE CORRECTION 确认)。

## What changes

- `driver-sql` (`schema-drift.ts`): new pure `parseFunctionalRowScopedGuard(expression)` reads MySQL 8's stored spelling of `metadata-protocol`'s package-less guard, `(case when (SCOPE is null) then DIGEST end)`, as a partial unique on the digest's columns scoped by SCOPE. `hasPartialUniqueGuard` accepts such an index (only key part, unique, no WHERE, no shadow carrier) when its columns are exactly the narrower key's, in key order, and its scope is the one nullable column the wider key gained. So the widening arm plans the same safe `replace_unique_index` it plans on PostgreSQL.
- Strict, derived from code: the digest must equal, in MySQL's stored spelling, what the new `hashShadowDigestSql(columns)` builds. That builder is the one `createHashShadowUniqueIndex` already used (extracted, byte-identical output), and it is the digest the three migrations key ("the driver's own hash-shadow digest"). Another function, hash, width, separator, scope, an `ELSE`, a NULL-safe part, a scope that is a key column or not the gained column, a second key part, a non-unique index, or two nullable gained columns: not a guard, the narrower key stays kept.
- MariaDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL paths unchanged; a shadow-carried narrower key is still kept whatever the guard.
- Tests: the MySQL cell of `sql-driver-widened-connection-key.test.ts` flips from the declared limit to the replace (same assertions as the PG cell); `sql-driver-widened-declared-unique.test.ts` (activation ledger) and `sql-driver-widened-grant-key.test.ts` (grant) gain pure pins over the measured MySQL expression plus a live MySQL 8 cell each (MariaDB skips them; the MariaDB cell is untouched).
- Docs: `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` ("Runtime-owned indexes apply builds") drops the MySQL limit; the guard docblock in `metadata-protocol`'s `connector-connection-packageless-index.ts` says the driver reads the form (comment only).
- Changeset: new `driver-sql` patch, FROM kept TO retired.

### DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`.changeset/31699-connection-key-package.md` is a pending (unreleased) note whose MySQL 8 bullet this PR makes false. Corrected sentence (the rest of the note unchanged):

> - MySQL 8, upgraded databases: `driver-sql` reads the guard's functional key part as the partial unique it is, so the old key retires there as it does on PostgreSQL, as one safe `replace_unique_index` on the next sync that runs safe drift. A database created fresh on MySQL 8 has the wide key and the guard and no old key. MySQL before 8.0.13 and MariaDB before 10.3 build no form, keep the old key (or build it under the driver's generated name where it is missing) and say so at `error` each boot.

`check-empty-changeset` is red on this file by design; the dispatching seat confirms by its record.

## Tests

Live MySQL 8.0.46 (local server; CI's `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` uses the official `mysql:8.0` image), at head `d0f178767f` (merge of origin/main over `b3e78bb48a`):

- The three widened-key suites with `OS_TEST_MYSQL_URL` set: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 60 passed | 2 skipped (62)`. The two skips are the PostgreSQL cell of the connection-key suite (no PG URL locally) and the MariaDB cell of the activation-ledger suite (the server is MySQL). All three MySQL cells ran and passed: connection key (flipped from the declared limit), grant key and activation ledger (new). Each live cell also asserts the stored `STATISTICS.EXPRESSION` text the pure pins read.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck`: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql test` with live MySQL, at `b3e78bb48a`: `Tests 3 failed | 5332 passed | 141 skipped`. All failures are live-MySQL environment cells outside this diff: four temporal / window cells need the skewed process zone CI sets (re-run with `TZ=America/New_York`: green), and `sql-driver-11565-row-byte-budget` (an InnoDB page-limit refusal on CREATE TABLE) does not fire on the locally packaged server. None reads index introspection or the widening arm. CI's live job is the reading of record for those cells.
- eslint (`--no-inline-config`) on the six changed source files: exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, restored; readings only)</summary>

All via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed `b01a23c36f` (tests import `src`, so no build leg; the tool restored each time, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):

1. The recognition removed (`functionalRowScopedGuardOf(p)` replaced by `null`): 5 red across the three suites, the 2 pure "counts as the guard" pins and all 3 live MySQL cells (the plan is no longer the replace). This is also the premise re-measure: without the recognition, the upgraded MySQL database keeps the old key.
2. The digest comparison deleted: 5 red (another hash width, another hash function, another separator, no hex decoding, an ELSE).
3. The scope check deleted: 2 red (a scope that is not the gained column; two nullable gained columns).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Claim file-surface extension (declared here): the comment-only docblock edit in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/migrations/connector-connection-packageless-index.ts` and the pending changeset correction above; both are sentences this diff made false.
- Measured: MySQL 8.0.46 stores the guard as `(case when (` + backquoted scope + ` is null) then unhex(sha2(concat(` + backquoted columns joined by `,0x1f,` + `),256)) end)` for all three tables; the live cells assert the stored text.
- PostgreSQL cell: run locally against a live PostgreSQL 16 (127.0.0.1, started for this run and removed after), and it passed. CI's `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` job runs the whole `driver-sql` suite against live PG and MySQL 8.0, but only on push to `main` and on schedule, not on `pull_request` or `merge_group`. On PR heads the live MySQL and PG cells are measured only by the local runs above.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families (dispatch-gates --commands, --ran reconciled)</summary>

At `b3e78bb48a`: 98 derived, 95 run, 3 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:type-check-debt`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, they need the whole workspace built; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs them). Red: `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main` exit 1, the DELIBERATE CORRECTION above, red by design. Four doc gates first exited 3 and were re-run green after building `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/client-react`. All other families exit 0. Re-derived and re-run on `d0f178767f`: see the os-dev-report comment on the card.

Post-merge scoped re-check (packages/spec moved upstream): `@objectstack/spec check:generated` reported `check:test-typecheck` red with "tsc failed without diagnostics" under the default heap; `check:test-typecheck` re-run under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` exit 0 (this diff does not touch `packages/spec`).
</details>
